subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 18=8 (a) In the evening a lion entered the cave. (b) One day, he fled from his master's house and look shelter in a cave. (c) Once upon a time, there lived a young man named Androcles. (d) He came near Androcles and lifted his paw. (e) He was caught by a slave merchant who sold him to a rich man in another country. (f) The lion seemed wounded as he was groaning. (g) His master was very bad and inflicted heavy torture on him. Androcles was very home sick. (h) He took the lion's paw in his hand and removed a big thorn from it. The lion was relieved of his pain.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
